summary: n8n's Possible Stored XSS in "Respond to Webhook" Node May Execute Outside iframe Sandbox
facts: A Respond to Webhook node returning attacker-controlled HTML with executable scripts may execute the payload in the top-level window instead of the expected sandbox.
The affected path wraps rendered HTML in an iframe whose sandbox policy is replaced by the selected fix.
The selected fix removes iframe response wrapping and applies a Content-Security-Policy sandbox header to rendered HTML webhook responses.

provenance.commit_role_basis: local Git: fixed commit is direct child of vulnerable commit; fix subject identifies CSP sandbox remediation

summary: WeKnora has Command Injection in MCP stdio test
facts: An authenticated user can place attacker-controlled stdio_config.command and stdio_config.args values in an MCP service configuration.
The vulnerable create flow stores the configuration without security filtering, and the test flow later reloads it from the repository.
Calling the MCP service test endpoint triggers Connect and then Start, which starts the configured subprocess.
The selected fix validates stdio command, arguments, and environment variables during create, update, and client construction.

provenance.commit_role_basis: official advisory references fix commit; local Git confirms vulnerable commit is its direct parent

summary: OpenClaw: browser.request still allows POST /reset-profile through the operator.write surface
facts: An authenticated caller limited to the operator.write browser.request surface can reach the destructive POST /reset-profile route.
The mutation classifier blocks profile creation and deletion but omits POST /reset-profile.
The reset operation may stop a running browser, closes the profile Playwright connection, and moves userDataDir to Trash only when that directory exists.

provenance.commit_role_basis: official advisory describes the missing reset-profile gate; local Git confirms the blocking fix is a direct child of the vulnerable commit

summary: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) has a Code Injection and Missing Authentication vulnerability
facts: An unauthenticated remote attacker can cause arbitrary code execution on a server hosting a vulnerable ADK instance.
The vulnerable route passes an attacker-controlled app_name into the agent loading path, which can reach dynamic module import.
The selected fix validates agent names before loading to prevent arbitrary module imports.

provenance.commit_role_basis: official advisory describes arbitrary code execution and patched versions; local Git confirms agent-name validation fix is a direct child of the vulnerable commit
